public_prompt: Implement src/security_tools.py with redact_bearer_tokens(text). Replace Bearer followed by one non-space token with Bearer [REDACTED]. Matching is case-sensitive. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/security_tools.py with redact_emails(text). Replace email-like addresses with [EMAIL]. Match a simple local@domain.tld shape. Preserve all other text. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/security_tools.py with redact_ipv4_last_octet(text). Replace the last octet of IPv4 addresses with x. For example 192.168.1.42 becomes 192.168.1.x. Leave invalid addresses unchanged. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/security_tools.py with safe_filename(name). Return a filesystem-safe filename: replace characters other than letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen with underscores, collapse repeated underscores, and strip leading/trailing underscores. Return 'untitled' if empty. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/security_tools.py with validate_relative_path(path). Return True if path is a safe relative path. Reject absolute paths, empty paths, and any path containing .. segments. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.
